items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Account Takeover
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated attackers to hijack customer accounts and escalate privileges. This flaw is actively being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Arbitrary Code Execution, Privilege Escalation, and Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, addressed in APSB26-73, could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, or security feature bypass upon successful exploitation.

items.title: Arbitrary Code Execution, Privilege Escalation, and Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: A critical vulnerability, part of the APSB26-73 update, could result in arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, or security feature bypass.

items.title: Arbitrary Code Execution, Privilege Escalation, and Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, addressed in APSB26-73, allows for arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could lead to arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: This high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security-Feature Bypass in B2B
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security-Feature Bypass
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass and requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security-Feature Bypass
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: This low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could result in privilege escalation, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Arbitrary Code Execution Vulnerability
items.summary: A critical vulnerability allowing arbitrary code execution was addressed in a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in the Amasty Order Attributes extension allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store, leading to remote code execution. This vulnerability has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload via REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw, named PolyShell, in Magento's REST API that enables unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files by disguising code as an image. A fix was released in Magento 2.4.9 on May 12, 2026, but older versions remain vulnerable.
